description: Adversarial split — scams engineered to EVADE current Sentinel signals (no keyword overlap: indirect payment, invented procedures, emotional family framing, casual authority) and hard-negative legitimate messages that share structural features with scams (money words, urgency-adjacent phrasing, real deliver tracking). This split measures GENERALIZATION, not category coverage. Scores here are expected to be lower than the core corpus — that is the honest finding.
